google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service has no ordering against google_project_service.project_services. When this module enables compute.googleapis.com for the service project, attachment can race API enablement, and teardown can disable the API before detachment. Wait for the managed Compute API service.

google_org_policy_policy.default does not wait for google_project_service.project_services. When orgpolicy.googleapis.com is enabled by this module in the API consumer project, policy operations can race enablement or run after API disablement during teardown. Order policies after that managed API.

google_logging_project_exclusion.logging-exclusion has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. If logging.googleapis.com is managed here, exclusions can race API enablement and can be deleted after the API is disabled. Wire the exclusion's project to the managed Logging API.

google_essential_contacts_contact.contact has no ordering against google_project_service.project_services. When essentialcontacts.googleapis.com is managed here and this project is the API consumer, contact creation can race enablement and deletion can follow disablement. This dependency is needed for that supported configuration; an externally managed billing/quota project's API must be handled separately.

google_project_iam_custom_role.roles has no ordering against google_project_service.project_services. When iam.googleapis.com is being enabled by this module, custom-role creation can call the IAM API before enablement completes; destruction can likewise disable the API before deleting the roles. Create custom roles after the managed IAM API.
